# cinder_ui v0.1.0 - Table of Contents

Shadcn UI Tailwind component library for Phoenix applications.

## Modules

- [CinderUI.Classes.TailwindCombine.ClassGroup](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Classes.TailwindCombine.ClassGroup.md)
- [CinderUI.Components.FieldFamily](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.FieldFamily.md): Structural field-family components for grouping and annotating form controls.
- [CinderUI.UI](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.UI.md): Facade module that delegates every component function, allowing conflict-free
access via a single alias.

- Core
  - [CinderUI](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.md): Entry-point helpers for the Cinder UI component system.
  - [CinderUI.Classes](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Classes.md): Utilities for composing Tailwind class lists.
  - [CinderUI.Hooks](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Hooks.md): JS hook integration helpers.
  - [CinderUI.Icons](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Icons.md): Optional Lucide icon integration for Cinder UI.
  - [CinderUI.JS](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.JS.md): LiveView JS helpers for controlling interactive Cinder UI components.
  - [CinderUI.Registry](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Registry.md): Canonical registry for Cinder UI component modules and metadata.

- Components
  - [CinderUI.Components](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.md): Aggregates all component modules.
  - [CinderUI.Components.Actions](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.Actions.md): Action-oriented shadcn-style components.
  - [CinderUI.Components.Advanced](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.Advanced.md): Higher-level components that map to shadcn patterns with progressive enhancement.
  - [CinderUI.Components.DataDisplay](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.DataDisplay.md): Data-display components following shadcn/ui structure where feasible.
  - [CinderUI.Components.Feedback](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.Feedback.md): Feedback and status components.
  - [CinderUI.Components.Forms](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.Forms.md): Form-related components modeled after shadcn/ui.
  - [CinderUI.Components.Layout](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.Layout.md): Layout and structural primitives inspired by shadcn/ui.
  - [CinderUI.Components.Navigation](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.Navigation.md): Navigation components aligned with shadcn structures.
  - [CinderUI.Components.Overlay](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.Overlay.md): Overlay and popup components.
  - [CinderUI.Components.Typography](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/CinderUI.Components.Typography.md): Typography recipes for semantic headings and text treatments.

## Mix Tasks

- Mix Tasks
  - [mix cinder_ui.install](https://cinder-ui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.CinderUi.Install.md): Installs Cinder UI into a Phoenix project.
